description:
Create a Telegram chat ID discovery token. Returns a deep_link, qr_code (base64 PNG), and qr_text (UTF-8 text QR for terminal display). The user opens the link in Telegram, which reveals their chat ID for approval channel setup.

Agent usage: pass the response's `deep_link` to render_auth_link so the user can click or scan it. Never hand `qr_text` to a link renderer — it is that same link already rendered as QR art. Print it verbatim inside a fenced code block only when a real terminal needs the QR. Then poll poll_chat_id_discovery with the returned token until the chat_id appears. Use the discovered chat_id when creating an approval channel with a Telegram channel.

The user does not see tool results — most clients fold them away, render_auth_link's output included. Before you wait or poll, put what the user must act on into your own reply text: the link itself (not a sentence announcing it), the SMS text and number, or a note to check their inbox.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: create_chat_id_discovery

outputSchema.description: Chat ID discovery token and Telegram deeplink

qr_code.description: QR code data URL for the deep link

qr_text.description: UTF-8 text representation of the QR code for terminal/agent display
